description_en: Sets the deletion protection attribute of an instance by calling ModifyClusterDeletionProtection
description_zh: 通过ModifyClusterDeletionProtection设置实例的是否删除保护属性
kebab_example: aliyun hbase modify-cluster-deletion-protection --cluster-id ld-0000000000000000 --protection true --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyClusterDeletionProtection

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection. Valid values:

true: Enables deletion protection. The cluster cannot be deleted when deletion protection is enabled.
false: Disables deletion protection. The cluster can be deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行删除保护。
true 设置后删除时会提示删除保护中不能删除。
false 设置后可随意删除
parameters.name: protection
